01 / A LOSSY REPRESENTATION

Same eigenvalues. Different port response.

Start with the detuned opposite-flux pair. Rows are output ports; columns are input ports. All values come from the recorded solver run.

Equivalence depends on what you keep fixed

Gauge copies preserve these intensities. In the symmetric zero-onsite triangle, reflection also identifies the opposite-flux designs if ports are relabelled together. Distinct onsite values remove that gauge-plus-permutation equivalence. Time reversal still relates the pair and must be declared if included in the quotient. These are finite-model statements, not bulk topological phases.

02 / EVIDENCE-TRIGGERED COMMUNICATION

Open a channel around a question.

Select a worker to inspect its own view. Connection highlights identify a temporary coalition, not continuous shared memory.

Local preview: a gated coalition opens and awaits an external worker output. The CLI implements cooldown, budget, dissolution, probes and reviewed edge updates.

Fast · separate views

Own observations, hypotheses, ranking, anomaly list and versioned schema fork. Six first passes were committed before reveal.

Medium · a bounded coalition

Spectrum, gauge and transport receive measured facts and published summaries. They return a descriptor, test or equivalence review, then dissolve.

Slow · schema proposal

Local forks coexist. Promotion requires adversarial checks and a separate human decision. No ontology was automatically changed.

Inspect the recorded coalition and agent outputs

03 / THREE ARCHIVES

Keep behavior, language and coordination distinct.

04 / RUN THE PROTOCOL

Bring a worker runtime.

The command-line adapter runs twelve bounded calls per arm with per-worker private state, a first-pass publication barrier, evidence allowlists and token accounting. You supply the adapter and provider credentials. This page makes no new AI calls.

python scripts/swarm_lab.py
python scripts/swarm_runtime.py --arm event \
  --adapter-json '["python", "my_agent_adapter.py"]' \
  --output /tmp/my-event-run

Other modes: single, broadcast, isolated. All receive the same cached physics evidence and aggregate token cap. This prototype compares communication on that evidence; it is not an adaptive materials search.
